v23_provenance_observability.key_residual: 81/768 design rows remain unresolved for exact activation history after complete occupancy plus equilibrium-provenance evidence

scientific_question: Can identical equilibrium occupancy and identical equilibrium source provenance still hide different colonization-age states, and does first-arrival timing recover ecologically relevant history left invisible by occupancy and provenance?

latent_rows.reuse: the exact 384 v21-v23 directed landscapes, clustered/dispersed three-source sets and three frozen activation histories

state_targets.equilibrium_occupancy: final union of nodes reachable from the three sources
state_targets.colonization_age_map: at a common row/design horizon T*, age(node)=T*-first_arrival(node), where T* is the maximum finite first-arrival time across all three histories and all non-source equilibrium nodes
state_targets.exact_activation_history: identity of H_anchor_first, H_second_first or H_third_first

source_node_rule: source nodes are excluded from first-arrival and colonization-age targets so activation time cannot be read directly from the source itself
primary_subset: all design rows are scored, with preregistered focus on the 81 v23 combined-full-history-unresolved rows
primary_outputs: equivalence-class count of histories under provenance map
number of v23 residual design rows with hidden first-arrival disagreement
number of v23 residual rows whose exact history becomes identifiable from the complete first-arrival map
number remaining exact-history unresolved even under complete first-arrival map
unique-origin versus confluence node fractions with history-dependent first-arrival time
rows where provenance map is invariant but first-arrival map differs

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one v23 combined-history-unresolved design row has different non-source first-arrival maps among its observationally aliased activation histories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every v23 residual alias also has an identical first-arrival map.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one v23 combined-history-unresolved design row becomes exactly activation-history-identifiable from the complete non-source first-arrival map.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if first-arrival state never resolves a v23 residual history.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one design row remains non-identifiable for exact activation history even after the complete non-source first-arrival map is known.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if complete first-arrival maps identify all histories everywhere.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one pair of activation histories shares the complete equilibrium provenance map but differs in complete first-arrival/colonization-age map.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if provenance equivalence always implies age equivalence.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one static unique-origin non-source node has invariant source provenance but different first-arrival time across activation histories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if all unique-origin nodes are history-invariant in first-arrival time.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one static confluence non-source node has different first-arrival time across activation histories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if confluence nodes never carry age memory.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every design row, the number of first-arrival-map equivalence classes is <= the number of exact activation histories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one design row has identical equilibrium occupancy across histories and positive first-arrival-map disagreement fraction.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if age-state disagreement never persists after occupancy convergence.

secondary_outputs: clustered versus dispersed contrast in first-arrival disagreement fraction
fraction of provenance-invariant rows with age-memory
relationship between v21 provenance disagreement and v24 age disagreement
relationship between v22/v23 observability status and age-map equivalence class count
claim_boundary: First-arrival time is structural graph-step time, not calibrated calendar age.
Colonization-age maps are derived known-truth state variables, not directly observed demographic age.
A hidden age difference is not evidence of demographic or evolutionary legacy unless a later model explicitly links age to a consequence.
v24 does not add extinction, abundance or persistence dynamics.
stop_rules: Do not include source-node activation times after scoring.
Do not add a new consequence model after scoring to force age relevance.
Do not change the common-horizon definition after scoring.
